entries.052900a9becac2ca: Since its founding, it has operated coffee shops mainly in Tokyo, with the corporate philosophy of providing a place of relaxation and rest to more customers. For sustainable growth and higher corporate value, it aims to accelerate openings of its main brand 'Kissashitsu Renoir,' expand its store areas across its brands mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area, and continue to reduce various costs, including streamlining staff allocation, while striving to provide high-quality products and hospitality-rich service.

entries.d5ac4ba34fee7d81: This is a single-segment business whose main operation is running coffee shops. As of March 31, 2026, the company operated 103 stores, comprising its 102 stores and one store of its consolidated subsidiary, GINZA RENOIR CO.,LTD, mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,347 million and the number of employees was 151. Sales by product category were ¥8,312 million for beverages and food, ¥32 million for miscellaneous goods and ¥1 million for other items. The consolidated subsidiary GINZA RENOIR CO.,LTD is one in which the company holds 50.0% of the voting rights, but which is included in the scope of consolidation by applying the control criterion; it is a specified subsidiary and is entrusted with store operations.
